strings.name: Grigori Perelman
strings.summary: Trained in Leningrad, Perelman studied curvature, manifolds and geometric analysis. His 2002–2003 preprints advanced Hamilton’s Ricci-flow program, providing crucial work proving the Poincaré and geometrization conjectures; other mathematicians checked and expanded the details. He also proved the soul conjecture, left his institute in 2005 and declined the Fields Medal and Clay prize money. Recent private circumstances are poorly documented; rumors are not grounds for health or family claims.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Completed important work proving the Poincaré conjecture, advancing geometric analysis and the theory of three-dimensional manifolds.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Leningrad, USSR, now St Petersburg, Russia; born June 13, 1966.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Ricci-flow breakthrough
strings.highlights.h1.text: Built on Hamilton’s research with new methods overcoming key obstacles in three-dimensional geometrization and the Poincaré problem.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated from Leningrad State University (1987); defended his thesis at the Steklov branch in 1990.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Declined major prizes
strings.highlights.h2.text: Declined the 2006 Fields Medal and 2010 Clay prize money; refusal does not alter scholarly recognition of his results.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Declined Clay prize money
strings.timeline.t1.text: After recognition for solving the Poincaré conjecture, declined the million-dollar prize.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Declined Fields Medal
strings.timeline.t2.text: The IMU honored his geometry and Ricci-flow work, but he did not accept the medal.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Left his institute
strings.timeline.t3.text: Resigned from the St Petersburg Steklov branch and gradually withdrew from public academic activity.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ricci flow with surgery paper
strings.timeline.t4.text: Submitted a technical preprint developing Ricci-flow analysis on three-manifolds.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First Ricci-flow preprint
strings.timeline.t5.text: Posted the entropy-formula paper to arXiv, advancing Hamilton’s geometrization program.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Proved the soul conjecture
strings.timeline.t6.text: Published a proof in Riemannian geometry and presented curvature research at the International Congress of Mathematicians.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Thesis defense
strings.timeline.t7.text: Defended a thesis on saddle surfaces in Euclidean spaces, trained under Burago and others.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Olympiad and university
strings.timeline.t8.text: Won a perfect-score International Mathematical Olympiad gold medal and entered Leningrad State University that year.
